test-strategy.purpose: Define the cheapest sufficient validation path for lazy-harness source, records, and runtime-package changes.

tiers.tier: Use only at a deliberate checkpoint after a coherent mutation batch for changed-file syntax, parse, path, and diff hygiene; never after every micro-edit.
Run the directly affected Python check function, Bun test target, package smoke, or typecheck at most once per changed-behavior batch when its source surface changed.
Run once after the final mutation. It performs fast validation and one full regression or conservatively reuses matching full-regression evidence.
Run only for an explicitly approved release/readiness boundary.

full-regression.rule: Direct full regression is reserved for explicit fresh validation or commit, push, and release gates.
Default execution uses at most four bounded audited process workers; out-of-range job counts are rejected and --jobs=1 provides serial fallback.
Pre-commit uses lazy test --light; pre-push uses full lazy test.

boundaries.boundary: Do not run `lazy check`, focused tests, typecheck, lint, build, or any other validation command after every individual edit; batch coherent mutations first.
Do not run product-wide lint, build, E2E, or unrelated downstream tests unless the user requests them or changed product code requires them.
Do not rerun full regression merely because an evidence capsule was updated.
Source, tests, contracts, policies, graph, planning, and canonical layer records remain full-regression fingerprint inputs.
Full-regression cache evidence is namespaced by resolved host root, dependency manifests/locks, and Python/Bun/Git toolchain signatures.
